paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 10
notes: Paper sets new limits on BOTH dark photon kinetic mixing (epsilon) and ALP axioelectric coupling (g_ae), assuming the particle is all of the galactic DM (rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3). Chose DarkPhoton per hint; an equally valid AxionElectron limit exists (g_ae below 1e-12 for few-hundred eV masses). Mass range 40 eV to 500 keV; new parameter space below ~1 keV. Numerical curves are only in figures (Fig.13 corrected); no data table available, so only the text-quoted point (epsilon < 1e-15 near 100 eV) is extractable.
